title: The Community Survey: What the Numbers Really Say · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
You are a volunteer in a local community group. Your group did a small survey about people's exercise habits. Write a short report (about 120–150 words) for the group. Describe the main numbers, compare two groups (for example, young people and older people), and explain one limitation of the survey. Use there was/were, percentages, and at least two trend verbs.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
